mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% in the current month and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS declines > 0.25pp over 3 months, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth is positive and UNRATE is below 5.0%, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate monetary or fiscal stimulus to support the economy.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 8.0%, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects economic weakness that suppresses corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 8.0% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) above 550,000 units per month signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 550.0, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST) and robust retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 550.0 and RSAFS > 350,000, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO growth rate < 0.0%), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO growth rate < 0.0%, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
